company.shortDescription: Artie is a technology platform that provides real-time data replication and streaming services to synchronize data across systems.
company.description: Artie is a technology platform that provides real-time data replication and streaming services to synchronize data across systems for AI and analytics use cases. It captures and moves only changed data from source databases into targets like data warehouses, handling schema evolution, pipeline monitoring, and consistency with low latency and minimal infrastructure maintenance. The platform supports flexible deployment options, observability tools, and integrations with popular databases and analytic destinations to help teams power applications with fresh, reliable data. Artie’s offering is centered on enabling data teams to reduce operational complexity while maintaining secure and continuous data flows.

productsAndServices.description: A managed change data capture and real-time replication platform that streams database changes to warehouses, lakes, and databases with sub-minute latency and exactly-once delivery.
